instruction.text: Molly is doing her weekly shop. Help her to complete the following calculations.

atoms.a: First, Molly buys 4 bunches of bananas. Each bunch has 4 bananas on it. How many bananas does Molly have altogether?
2 bunches of bananas will cost Molly £4. How much does 1 bunch of bananas cost?
If 1 bunch of bananas will cost Molly £2, how much will 4 bunches of bananas cost?

instruction.text: Molly is doing her weekly shop. Help her to complete the following calculations.

atoms.a: Next, Molly wants to buy some bread rolls. She needs 24 rolls and there are 6 rolls in each pack. How many packs of rolls does she need?
4 packs of bread rolls cost Molly £12. How much will 3 packs cost?

instruction.text: Molly is doing her weekly shop. Help her to complete the following calculations.

atoms.a: Finally, Molly treats herself to some fairy cakes. In a pack, there are 9 chocolate and 3 red velvet cakes. If Molly were to buy 15 red velvet cakes, how many chocolate cakes would she get?
If 2 packs of cakes will cost Molly £8, how much will three packs of cakes cost?
